title: Тёмная пробка и деревянная рамка
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied finished DETECTUM investigation-board concept.
Primary request: make a new version of this SAME board with a beautiful real wooden frame and a noticeably darker natural cork surface, suitable for the site's warm, moody detective style.
Change the complete rectangular metal frame to dark walnut hardwood: refined medium-narrow beveled rails, convincing subtle walnut grain following each rail, clean mitred corners, small natural worn edges, restrained warm lamp highlights. The frame is elegant and practical, never ornate or bulky; keep the whole frame visible and the current board bounds. Retain small aged brass corner hardware if it fits naturally in the wood.
Change the green-gray painted metal FIELD only to dark tobacco / espresso-brown natural cork, approximately #4D392B under neutral light. It must look distinctly darker and more muted than ordinary golden-orange bulletin-board cork, still visibly natural cork with crisp small irregular compressed cork granules and slight warm tonal variation. Fine, restrained low-contrast grain; no large repeated spots, no fuzzy noise, no artificial stone or leather texture, no metal scratches or rust on this cork. The dark warm cork gives pale papers excellent contrast. A soft restrained upper-left warm light, no strong yellow hotspot.
Keep unchanged: exact front-facing landscape composition, note and photograph positions and sizes, every piece of paper, its pastel color, handwriting, shadows and readable Russian text, all the existing round colored attachment caps/discs in the same positions, fine twisted red thread geometry and red color, toolbar text and design, add button, lower-right zoom controls, and believable tactile realistic rendering. Do not change the visual design of the circular attachment objects. Red strings stay as in the supplied concept.
Only replace the board FIELD material/color and the FRAME material. Preserve all other content and the current palette accents. Full completed concept art, not a material swatch, no split panels or comparisons, no extra objects, no browser chrome, no new labels, no people, no hands, no watermark. Crisp premium photographic game-interface concept, warm analog noir, understated archival craftsmanship.
